scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student from a recognized university/institute.

Must be enrolled in one of the following programs: 5‑year Integrated M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech./M.Tech. (7th‑9th semester), 3‑year M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech. (3rd‑5th semester), 2‑year MSc./M.Sc. Tech./M.Tech. (2nd‑3rd semester), or B.Sc final year.
benefits_summary: Certificate of Internship awarded upon successful completion; no financial aid or stipend provided.
